owned_invariants: The task is roots, a nonempty list of exact rationals, and optionally max_attempts, an exact integer from 1 to 8; without it the limit is 3.

Each reply is sorted by monic.rs. A kind of mistake not yet seen in this run adds that kind's antibody to the set; a kind seen before adds nothing. The set keeps the order in which the kinds were first seen.
After a rejected round the next prompt is the task as written with the whole set of antibodies under it as the residual.
An antibody is one of five fixed sentences, chosen by the kind of mistake alone. No coefficient, root or part of a reply is ever written into one.
A reply that is not text uses up a round and adds no antibody.

The loop and its verdict are WF9's: certified when a reply is the expected polynomial written canonically, refused as REPAIR_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED otherwise. The verdict also gives the number of antibodies.
boundaries: The antibody sentences are advice in the prompt. Nothing checks that a later reply follows them; only the final polynomial is checked.
The sentence for a wrong value says the coefficients do not vanish at the roots. It does not say which coefficient is wrong.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
